literal_meaning: মনের চঞ্চলতা বা অস্থিরতা (ছন-এর মতো শব্দধ্বনি এবং মন)
figurative_meaning_en: Indicating discomfort, restlessness, anxiety, and similar states
example_sentences_in_english: The student was fidgety before the exam.
note: This idiom captures a colloquial expression of mental unease in Bengali vernacular.
